note: Friendly but confused, polite, a stranger walked up to him.
Warm, easy, totally sure, like greeting an old friend, a little hurt he even asked.

text: I think you mixed me up with someone.
note: Kind, gently offering a way out, a small awkward laugh in the voice.

text: Is your mum still doing Sunday dinner?
note: Casual, confident, cheeky, as if he has been many times.
Slow, thrown, a pause before it, confused but honest.

text: So how did you two meet?
note: Delighted, warm, loud, beaming at both boys across the dinner table.
Calm, sweet, completely straight-faced, like it is a lovely story.
Quick, flat, under his breath, firm.
